sections.title: Why we build our own tools
paragraphs: A lot of video work repeats every week: the same lower thirds, the same highlight cuts, the same checks before something ships. Small tools do those parts the same way every time, so the time goes into the parts that need a person.

They cover highlight reels and vertical clips, talking-head edits with captions, animated logos, explainers and static websites. The motion on this page runs on the same spring maths the engine uses for video graphics.
